text.tspan: Covers US 1.0.1, 1.0.3 and 1.0.4. "(Proposed)" = the step is not in the code on main as of October 7, 2026.

text.tspan: Session checked on server. Approval is checked only
in the client ProtectedRoute. Reads then use
Role read from auth app_metadata.role, display only.
If people.auth_user_id is null, the route returns
zero stats and runs no inspection queries.
Data is read again on each load, with no cache (1.0.1 AT5).
A new SIR adds 1 to the count on next load (1.0.4 AT2).
Only active web SIRs (form_responses.is_active) are counted.
Open questions: which answers count as "activities",
and how a steward marks answers as hidden.

svg.text: Select "Submitted by" name on a SIR on /detail/[namesite]
(own profile: no personId, page defaults to 1)
Read people (display_name, skills, focus_areas) with socials
(email, phone, website, instagram, facebook, x, linkedin)
by id = personId, or by auth_user_id = session user
with sites_pa name, count exact, range 10 per page
Show profile, quick stats and SIR history
Select a SIR in the history
Open /detail/[namesite] of that SIR's site (not scrolled to the SIR)
or /sites if there is no history
